project: Browser WebXR + Depth Anything room scanner for acoustic digital twins
goal: closed metric wall/floor/ceiling shell with per-surface texture plus separate removable internal 3D objects
primary_rule: user local footprint is authoritative inside each cell; walls do not rotate from Deep/XR evidence; cells merge rigidly through portals

xr.session_policy: one immersive-ar/local-floor session for all cells in a scan; only Termina intera scansione ends it normally
xr.camera: WebXR raw camera only; camera-access required; never getUserMedia/ImageCapture
xr.capture_lifetime: UI/AutoSurvey queues captureRequest; raw RGB + pose + projection + optional depth copied only inside the next active XR rAF callback; JPEG after callback
xr.live_budget: pose + floor pointer + small depth sampling + RGB only when needed; no Deep/TSDF/ICP/global optimizer
xr.movement: guided short movement within the same XR session is intentional for parallax and object persistence

autosurvey.rotate: 24-sector weak-direction guidance with left/right, raise/lower, slow and STOP; automatic synchronized capture when stable
autosurvey.parallax: up to 3 safe in-footprint targets around 0.38m from station; then look at weakest wall and auto-capture
autosurvey.manual: Scatto extra remains available; Salta guida can bypass incomplete AutoSurvey with warning

objects.representation: RGB voxel/point population is real geometry; OBB is UI proxy; optional voxel surface mesh for OBJ
objects.persistence: spatialViewId quantizes physical camera position; require >=2 distinct spatial view clusters OR XR+Deep agreement
objects.important_fix: never use timestamp-only frame IDs to claim multi-view support

deep.policy: batch-only after full XR scan finalization
deep.role: relative-depth foreground/object completion and texture support against known cell shell; never wall orientation
deep.memory: discard full Deep map after classification

portals.source: user marks opening interval on source wall
portals.target: auto-match compatible wall in next cell
portals.shared_wall: suppress only duplicated target interval; keep source wall with portal cutout
portals.top: may be inferred from persistent behind-shell Deep evidence

height: one planar ceiling per local cell; infer from known wall plane + wall-ceiling image edge/ray; ask for/tap full wall floor-to-ceiling view when confidence is weak
texture: per-wall metric atlas from multiple photos; mask foreground objects where evidence exists; optical RGB may be kept while optical depth is rejected
known_fixed_bugs: raw camera optional instead of required
do_not_reintroduce: pretending a restarted XR session is automatically metrically aligned
next_device_tests: chair/cabinet colored object cloud with parallax
narrow corridor multiple partial wall views
